bundle.shortDescription: Drop your ebooks in. Get one organized library with clean metadata and a reading log.
bundle.longDescription: Bookdrop turns dropped EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, RTF, DOCX, HTML, and TXT files into clean EPUBs in one flat library folder. It fetches metadata and covers, lets you edit both, and tracks reading status with private notes.
